content.text: nbformat is in the venv. Stripping outputs from all 9 notebooks:

input.command:
.venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import nbformat
from pathlib import Path

for p in sorted(Path('notebooks').glob('*.ipynb')):
    nb = nbformat.read(p, as_version=4)
    changed = False
    for cell in nb.cells:
        if cell.cell_type == 'code' and (cell.get('outputs') or cell.get('execution_count') is not None):
            cell.outputs = []
            cell.execution_count = None
            changed = True
    if changed:
        nbformat.write(nb, p)
    print(('stripped ' if changed else 'clean     ') + str(p))
EOF
